zh.title: 海軍陸戰隊12月將實彈操演 勁蜂一型攻擊無人機參訓
zh.summary: 海軍陸戰隊12月8日將於高雄左營海灘一帶實彈操演，勁蜂一型攻擊無人機參訓
body: 海軍陸戰隊預定12月8日在高雄左營海灘一帶實施「聯合作戰計畫演練實彈射擊」。中科院研製的勁蜂一型攻擊型無人機將投入此次操演，由兩棲偵搜大隊偵二中隊操作。
根據漁業署射擊通報資訊，海空域管制時間為下午4時至晚上8時，實際實彈射擊則預定於下午4時30分至晚上7時進行。此次演練所射擊的彈藥共超過5萬1000發。
中央社報導，預定參與操演的勁蜂一型具備光電與紅外線（EO/IR）設備，可在日間及夜間進行搜索。

en.title: Marine Corps to Use Attack Drone in December Live-Fire Drill
en.summary: The Marine Corps plans a December 8 live-fire drill in Kaohsiung with an attack drone.
body: The Marine Corps plans to hold a joint operational plan live-fire exercise around Zuoying Beach in Kaohsiung on December 8. An attack drone known as 勁蜂一型, developed by 中科院, is scheduled to take part and be operated by the amphibious reconnaissance unit’s Second Reconnaissance Squadron.

The Fisheries Agency’s firing notice lists sea and airspace control from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Live firing is scheduled from 4:30 p.m. to 7 p.m. The exercise is expected to use more than 51,000 rounds of ammunition.
CNA reported that the drone has electro-optical and infrared (EO/IR) equipment and can conduct searches by day and night.

zh.title: 亞太永續航空燃料大會在新加坡登場 2030年目標佔比3%至5%
zh.summary: 亞太永續航空燃料大會在新加坡展開；2030年SAF目標佔比3%至5%。
body: 亞太永續航空燃料大會23日在新加坡展開，來自各地的產官學界代表討論政策規範等議題。
新加坡希望從當地起飛的航班逐步使用永續航空燃料（SAF），初步目標是讓SAF佔飛機燃油量的1%。到2030年，目標比例為3%至5%，具體數字將視全球市場發展與供應情況而定。
新加坡民航局宣佈，自2027年1月起，對從新加坡出發的起訖點旅客，以及通用航空與商務航空航班，加徵永續航空燃料徵費。徵費適用於今年10月1日起售出的機票或相關服務。
依民航局公佈的標準，從新加坡飛往曼谷的經濟艙乘客將多付新幣1元。

en.title: Sustainable aviation fuel conference opens in Singapore; 2030 share target is 3% to 5%
en.summary: Asia-Pacific sustainable aviation fuel conference opens in Singapore; Singapore targets a 3% to 5% share by 2030.
body: The Asia-Pacific sustainable aviation fuel conference opened in Singapore on the 23rd, with industry, government and academic representatives discussing policy and regulatory issues.

Singapore's initial goal is for sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) to account for 1% of aircraft fuel as flights departing Singapore gradually adopt it. The target is 3% to 5% by 2030, with the exact figure depending on global market developments and supply.

The Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) has announced a SAF levy from January 2027 for origin-and-destination passengers departing Singapore and for general and business aviation flights. It applies to tickets or related services sold from October 1 this year.
Under the authority's published schedule, economy-class passengers flying from Singapore to Bangkok would pay an additional Singapore dollar.

zh.title: LATAM Airlines公佈A321XLR客艙設計 規劃搭載174名乘客
zh.summary: LATAM Airlines公佈A321XLR客艙設計，規劃搭載174名乘客。
body: LATAM Airlines公佈未來空中巴士A321XLR機隊的客艙設計。飛機規劃搭載174名乘客，將配置12間Premium Business商務艙套房及162個經濟艙座位，其中36個經濟艙座位的空間將較寬敞。
Thompson Aero Seating的VantageSOLO套房將採全平躺設計，以1-1排列，設有隱私門並可直接通往走道。每間套房將配備19吋OLED螢幕。
LATAM已訂購13架A321XLR，預計自2027年3月起加入機隊。這批飛機原先規劃主要自祕魯利馬（LIM）營運。
AeroTime報導，LATAM與祕魯政府就引入新乘客稅持續存在爭議，航空公司未排除將這批飛機部署至其他市場。

en.title: LATAM Airlines unveils A321XLR cabin design for 174 passengers
en.summary: LATAM Airlines unveils its A321XLR cabin design, with planned capacity for 174 passengers.
body: LATAM Airlines has unveiled the cabin design for its upcoming Airbus A321XLR fleet. The aircraft will be configured to carry 174 passengers, with 12 Premium Business suites and 162 Economy seats. Of the Economy seats, 36 will have more space.
The Thompson Aero Seating VantageSOLO suites will be fully lie-flat, arranged in a 1-1 layout with direct aisle access and privacy doors. Each suite will have a 19-inch OLED screen.
LATAM has 13 A321XLRs on order, which are expected to join its fleet from March 2027. The aircraft were originally slated to operate primarily from Lima (LIM), Peru.
AeroTime reports that LATAM has not ruled out deploying the aircraft to other markets amid an ongoing dispute with the Peruvian government over the introduction of a new passenger tax.
